question: In Slack: Add a white_check_mark reaction to the Q3 results message that includes the chart image.
final: Done — with one caveat: I found the right message (Maya's "Q3 results are in: growth is up 8%." in `#bulletins`, the one with the Q3 growth chart image) and added a reaction. However, this Slack environment rejected `white_check_mark` as an invalid emoji name (same for `check_mark`, `checkmark`, etc.), so I used `check` — the only check-mark reaction this workspace supports. The message now has ✅ (check) on it, and I cleaned up the test reactions I added while finding a valid name. If you have the exact emoji name this workspace expects, I can re-apply it.

Initiates a public or private channel-based conversation.
